New plan: 

In my last attempt, I correctly identified the last day of the first quarter of 2008 as March 31, 2008. However, I failed to consider the fact that the question asks for the date 24 hours later, which would be April 1, 2008. But I didn't consider the fact that the first day of April 2008 is indeed April 1, 2008, and the date 24 hours later would be April 2, 2008, not April 1, 2008. 

Next time, I will make sure to consider the fact that the date 24 hours later would be the next day, not the same day.
